In spite of inviting county and local candidates to these events and asking for help and volunteering my help to others the responses have been nil. There's also a flurry of people waging write-in campaigns who didn't make it through the primary and quite honestly they missed their opportunities and I fear are now just wasting money and time when they need to be helping the others who are conservative and managed to get on the ballot with another party affiliation (Independent, Libertarian, Constitution, etc...) to oust the old guard RINOs. Many at the potluck (including candidates!) were unaware. I am not seeing Committeemen and Committeewomen in attendance and I am baffled. In fact I have lives in my home since 1999 and have never had a committeeman or committeewoman make an effort to introduce themselves to me. I just learned yesterday that I am on the November ballot from someone who waging a write-in campaign. I am excited to move forward and have reached out to the state GOP (yesterday) and haven't heard back yet. I am mindful of the calendar and changing weather and want to reach out to as many voters as possible as soon as possible. My question to everyone is how I can make this happen more quickly and "AM I DOIING THIS RIGHT???" Am I coming on too strong? Do I sit back and lose now, then wait for 2024?
